items.title: Checkout Timeout Runbook
items.content: Use this runbook when checkout requests time out while waiting on the inventory service. Symptoms: Payment or checkout API requests fail with TimeoutException. The failing route is usually /checkout. Logs mention waiting for inventory reservation or stock confirmation. Immediate checks: Confirm inventory service health and request latency. Check the checkout API outbound timeout and retry settings. Compare timeout spikes with inventory deployment or database saturation events. Recommended action: Reduce checkout retry fan-out, verify inventory capacity, and fail gracefully with a retryable user-facing message until inventory latency returns to baseline.

items.title: Known Incident: Checkout Inventory Timeout
items.content: Known incident pattern for checkout failures caused by inventory latency. Matching signals usually contain service name payments-api or checkout-api, error type TimeoutException, and messages mentioning checkout timeout, inventory timeout, stock reservation, or inventory dependency latency. Prior resolution: Inventory request latency increased after a connection-pool configuration change. Restoring the pool limit and restarting saturated inventory workers stopped checkout timeouts.

items.title: Notification Dispatch Backlog Runbook
items.content: Use this runbook when notifications-api reports QueueSaturatedException and the dispatch queue backlog keeps growing. Symptoms: delivery lag alerts on /notifications/dispatch, rising queue depth per channel, and retries that never drain. Immediate checks: Confirm the dispatch worker count, inspect queue depth per channel, and compare the backlog with the last notifications-api deployment. Recommended action: Add dispatch workers, shed low-priority channels, and hold the retry interval steady so it does not compound until queue depth returns to baseline.

Shed low-priority notification channels and hold the retry interval steady until dispatch queue depth in notifications-api returns to baseline.

items.title: Search Index Lag Runbook
items.content: Use this runbook when search-indexer reports IndexLagException and search results go stale. Symptoms: a reindex backlog on /search/reindex, growing document age, and partial result sets. Immediate checks: Compare indexer throughput with the ingest rate, confirm the reindex worker is still claiming batches, and look for a poison document blocking a batch. Recommended action: Pause low-priority reindex batches, raise indexer concurrency, and let the lag drain before reprocessing the blocked document.

items.title: Session Eviction Storm Runbook
items.content: Use this runbook when session-store reports SessionNotFoundException and signed-in users are logged out in bursts. Symptoms: eviction storms after a memory pressure spike, sudden drops in live session count, and repeated re-authentication. Immediate checks: Confirm the eviction policy and memory headroom, compare the storm with a session payload size regression, and check replica lag. Recommended action: Raise memory headroom, cap session payload size, and stagger eviction so the store never sheds a whole shard at once.

items.title: Report Export Timeout Runbook
items.content: Use this runbook when report-export reports ExportTimeoutException on /reports/export. Symptoms: scheduled exports that time out before the first page is written, long-running queries against the reporting replica, and export jobs stuck in the running state. Immediate checks: Confirm reporting replica lag, inspect the slowest export query plan, and compare the timeout with the configured export page size. Recommended action: Reduce the export page size, move the schedule off the replica maintenance window, and fail the job fast so the next run is not blocked.

items.title: Feature Flag Evaluation Fallback Runbook
items.content: Use this runbook when flag-service reports FlagEvaluationException and /flags/evaluate falls back to default values. Symptoms: every request served with default flag values, a stale rules snapshot, and evaluation errors that clear on restart. Immediate checks: Confirm the rules snapshot version in use, check the flag store connection, and compare the fallback with the last rules publish. Recommended action: Republish the last good rules snapshot, keep the cached snapshot serving while the store recovers, and alert on snapshot age rather than on evaluation errors alone.

items.title: Orders Fulfillment Backlog Runbook
items.content: Use this runbook when orders-api reports FulfillmentBacklogException and the fulfillment backlog keeps growing after release 7.1.0. Symptoms: orders accepted faster than the fulfillment workers drain them, rising order age, and warehouse callbacks that arrive late. Immediate checks: Confirm the fulfillment worker count, compare the accepted order rate with the drained rate, and look for a single slow warehouse partner. Recommended action: Scale fulfillment workers, throttle the slow partner, and hold new promotions until order age returns to baseline.
